parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Recipients
parameters.description: The email address of the recipient. Separate multiple email addresses with commas (,).

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-report-recipient-status --source-ip 39.174.xxx.xxx --lang zh --recipients username@example.com,username@example.com --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
